title: The Inventory of the fourth floor walk-up
author: Sebastian Delacroix
blurb: Mara Sterling, an heir cataloging a parent's silence after the funeral, keeps a careful inventory of everything unsaid. But when a childhood home goes up for auction, he discovers that staying invisible was never really an option. Now he must say goodbye properly, at last, out loud, and time is already running out.
style: vivid, cinematic prose with tight pacing
